* [Download release](https://github.com/hooklift/gowsdl/releases)

## Usage

```
Usage: gowsdl [options] myservice.wsdl
  -o string
        File where the generated code will be saved (default "myservice.go")
  -p string
        Package under which code will be generated (default "myservice")
  -i    Skips TLS Verification
  -v    Shows gowsdl version
```

* Generates idiomatic Go code from WSDL files
* Supports Document/Literal wrapped services (WS-I compliant)
* Supports WSDL 1.1, XML Schema 1.0, and SOAP 1.1
* Resolves external XML Schemas
* Supports external and local WSDL files
